meaning:
κλέος, -ους, τό
[in LXX: Job.28:22 (שֵׁמַע) Job.30:8 * ;]
1. a rumour, report.
2. good report, fame, glory: 1Pe.2:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
